body:
This is not a correct fix. And we don't accept AI generated code from new contributors. Please try to understand the problem before asking the AI to solve it for you. 

Take a look at the PR that caused the regression and make sure you understand why the code involved introduced the regression. Then modify it so it doesn't create this bug. Introducing an entirely new concept like this is way too hacky and it adds complexity in a place that should not be complex. 

I'm going to close this PR since it is unacceptable for multiple reasons. But if you think you can understand what the problem is and how it should be solved, then feel free to open another PR. 

This is an area where the AI will do more harm then help. Since it will suggest complex solutions like this even though the real solution will be much simpler.

I did take a look at the PR that caused the regression. The reason that I decided to try this issue, even thought I've been using godot for 5/6 months is because I felt it was obvious that the problem stemmed from the change in `_get_sky_material_data()` and that function being called for two different things.
Now, as per my AI disclosure, I used ChatGPT as a rubber ducky. The code is mine.
You may be entirely right that there is a simpler solution and I knew that this solution could be controversial as adding a parameter to a function so that it has "mode A" and "mode B" of working is basically meh.

You are entirely wrong to thing that I've vibe coded this solution.

I'll try finding a simpler solution.

@clayjohn
